name: Panther
tagline: A browser that blocks ads, trackers, and shows what sites are doing
description:
Panther is a privacy-focused Android browser with an ad blocker and tracker blocker built in, so you see less clutter and get followed around the web less. For anyone curious about what a site is actually doing, it also includes a console and traffic logs you can dig into.

It even supports scripting, letting more technical users tweak or automate how pages behave, while staying just as usable as a normal browser for everyday browsing.
